description: A chess game box sits on a bare tabletop, and a yellow-and-black tape measure is in use above it. The right hand grips the tape measure housing and pulls the tape out to the left across the top of the box while the left hand reaches in to pinch and guide the tape near the box’s left edge; after a brief pause, the right hand retracts the tape and then repositions it to measure in the other direction, with the left hand steadying the tape against the box.
